top_signals.title: Oil Tops $110 for First Time Since May as Supply Risk Grows
top_signals.summary: Brent oil hit $110 a barrel for the first time since May as prospects for imminent supply relief dwindle, prompting traders to ramp up bullish bets ahead of the weekend.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: US Army’s 8th Psychological Operations Group inactivated
top_signals.summary: The Army's 8th Psychological Operations Group inactivated as the service reshapes its PSYOP and information warfare forces to counter global adversaries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
